description: Sandbox probes for the container tier: identity and capability, network, runtime socket, and mount probes, and a canary reader that searches the container environment, process environments, and filesystem for host canary values.

entries.content:
for s in /var/run/docker.sock /run/docker.sock /run/podman/podman.sock; do
  if [ -e "$s" ]; then echo "$s present"; else echo "$s absent"; fi
done

env
for f in /proc/[0-9]*/environ; do
  tr '\000' '\n' < "$f" 2>/dev/null
done
find / -path /proc -prune -o -path /sys -prune -o -path /dev -prune -o -type f -exec grep -a -H PATCH_STEWARD_CANARY {} + 2>/dev/null
echo canary-scan-done
